normalization.paths: $ROOT denotes the isolated case root; all symlinks are real POSIX symlinks
normalization.dependencySha256: Actual old current() sha is verified against its actual graph; check relocates graph paths to frozenRoot/caseId for stable digest comparison. At --write the frozen digest equals the actual old digest.
normalization.defaultSource: Actual six-field stat identities and original sidecar bytes are frozen. Check maps each newly observed identity to the corresponding frozen statIdentities slot, preserving equality/inequality; no stat call in old code is patched. All marker and quarantine bytes are hex.
normalization.clock: time.time fixed to 1700000000 for activation receipts; stat clocks and inode identities are real
normalization.injections: Per-case injections enumerate all decision-affecting patches; queue/current wrappers execute real implementations. Synthetic registries are subsets of current signed names.
